questions.question:
다음 문장의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
We should bring not ___________ pencils but also erasers.
questions.explanation: 'A뿐만 아니라 B도'라는 뜻의 상관접속사는 'not only A but also B'이므로 빈칸에는 only가 알맞습니다.

questions.question:
다음 문장의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
Tom can play not only the piano ___________ also the violin.
questions.explanation: 'not only A but also B' 구문에서 빈칸에는 but이 들어가야 합니다.

questions.question:
다음 문장의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
• Not only I but also my sister (A)__________ interested in music.
• Sam not only cooks but also (B)__________ the dishes.
questions.explanation: 'not only A but also B'의 수일치는 B(my sister)에 맞추므로 is가 되고, 병렬 구조에서 cooks와 대응하는 형태인 washes가 알맞습니다.

questions.question:
다음 문장의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
• Not only the coach but also the players (A)__________ the trophy.
• My sister enjoys not only reading books but also (B)__________ movies.
questions.explanation: 'not only A but also B'의 수일치는 B(the players, 복수)에 맞춰 want, 병렬 구조에서 reading과 대응하는 watching → want / watching.

questions.question:
다음 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
Not only he _______________ I am tired. = I as well as he am tired.
questions.explanation: 'not only A but also B'와 'B as well as A'는 같은 의미이므로 빈칸에는 but also가 알맞습니다.

questions.question:
다음 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
The boy is not only kind but also brave. = The boy is brave ___________ kind.
questions.explanation: 'not only A but also B'는 'B as well as A'로 바꿔 쓸 수 있으므로 빈칸에는 as well as가 알맞습니다.

questions.question:
다음 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
Jane can speak Chinese as well as Japanese. = Jane can speak not only Japanese ___________ Chinese.
questions.explanation: 'B as well as A'는 'not only A but also B'로 바꿔 쓸 수 있으므로 빈칸에는 but also가 알맞습니다.

questions.question:
다음 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
The festival was held in May. It was held in June, too. = The festival was held (A)__________ in May (B)__________ in June.
questions.explanation: 'A와 B 둘 다'라는 의미이므로 'both A and B'가 알맞습니다.

questions.question:
빈칸에 들어갈 말이 순서대로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• Either Sam __________ you have the key.
• Both Tom and Jane __________ ready to leave.
• Amy as well as I __________ with the plan.
questions.explanation: 'either A or B'는 or, 'both A and B'는 복수 취급 are, 'B as well as A'는 앞 주어(Amy, 3인칭 단수)에 수일치하여 agrees → or / are / agrees.

options: not only visited but also worked at
not only Jane but also her sister
not only wide but also colorful
not only by students but also by teachers
not only French songs but also Korean songs
questions.question:
다음 문장의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것은? (단, 순서는 관계없음)
• The library has been used __________________.
• I think __________________ doesn't like carrots.
• The garden was __________________________________.
• She ____________________ many famous museums.
questions.explanation: 동사 자리에는 '방문하고 일했다'는 ①이, 주어 자리에는 ②가, 보어 자리에는 ③이, 수동태 뒤에는 ④가 알맞습니다. ⑤는 목적어(명사구)여서 어느 빈칸에도 자연스럽게 들어가지 않습니다.

options: Either Mike or I has a bike.
Not Mike but I have a bike.
Not only I but also Mike has a bike.
Mike as well as I has a bike.
Not only Mike but also I have a bike.
questions.question:
다음 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것은?
Mike뿐만 아니라 나도 자전거를 가지고 있다.
questions.explanation: 'A뿐만 아니라 B도'는 'not only A but also B'이며 동사는 B(I)에 맞춰 have를 씁니다. 따라서 ⑤가 알맞습니다.

options: Jenny bought a notebook and a pen.
Jenny bought not a notebook but a pen.
Jenny bought not only a pen but also a notebook.
Jenny bought a notebook as well as a pen.
Jenny bought not only a notebook but also a pen.
questions.question:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
Jenny는 공책뿐만 아니라 펜도 샀다.
questions.explanation: 'A뿐만 아니라 B도'는 'not only A but also B'이므로 '공책(A)뿐만 아니라 펜(B)도'는 not only a notebook but also a pen이 알맞습니다.

options: Dogs as well as cats make good pets.
Not only dogs but also cats make good pets.
Not cats but dogs make good pets.
questions.question:
다음 주어진 문장과 의미가 같은 것은?
Cats as well as dogs make good pets.
questions.explanation: 'B as well as A'는 'A뿐만 아니라 B도'라는 뜻으로 'not only A but also B'와 같습니다. 'Cats as well as dogs'는 'dogs뿐만 아니라 cats도'이므로 'Not only dogs but also cats'와 의미가 같습니다.

options: Tom doesn't play the guitar or the drums.
Tom plays the drums as well as the guitar.
Tom plays not the guitar but the drums.
Tom plays the drums, not the guitar.
Tom plays the guitar, but he doesn't play the drums.
questions.question:
다음 주어진 문장과 의미가 같은 것은?
Tom plays not only the guitar but also the drums.
questions.explanation: 'not only A but also B'는 'B as well as A'로 바꿀 수 있습니다. 'not only the guitar but also the drums'는 'the drums as well as the guitar'와 같은 의미입니다.

options: Jake doesn't cook well but paints well.
Jake paints well as well as cooks well.
Jake cooks well because he paints well.
questions.question:
다음 주어진 문장과 의미가 같은 것은?
Jake not only cooks well but paints well.
questions.explanation: 'not only A but B'는 'A뿐만 아니라 B도'라는 뜻으로, 'B as well as A'로 바꿀 수 있습니다. 'not only cooks well but paints well'은 'paints well as well as cooks well'과 같습니다.

options: Leonardo was not a painter but he is an inventor.
Leonardo was neither a painter nor an inventor.
Leonardo was an inventor as well as a painter.
Leonardo was either a painter or an inventor.
Leonardo was a painter, not an inventor.
questions.question:
다음 주어진 문장과 의미가 같은 것은?
Leonardo was not only a painter but also an inventor.
questions.explanation: 'not only A but also B'는 'B as well as A'로 바꿀 수 있습니다. 'not only a painter but also an inventor'는 'an inventor as well as a painter'와 같은 의미입니다.

options: Not you but Lisa is chosen as the leader.
Not Lisa but you are chosen as the leader.
Not only Lisa but also you are chosen as the leader.
Not only you but also Lisa is chosen as the leader.
Neither you nor Lisa is chosen as the leader.
questions.question:
다음 주어진 문장과 의미가 같은 것은?
Lisa as well as you is chosen as the leader.
questions.explanation: 'B as well as A'는 'not only A but also B'로 바꿀 수 있습니다. 'Lisa as well as you'는 'not only you but also Lisa'가 되고, 동사는 뒤(B)인 Lisa에 맞춰 is를 씁니다.

options: She only sent him a gift.
She sent either a letter or a gift to him.
She sent a gift as well as a letter to him.
She sent neither a letter nor a gift to him.
She sent not a letter but a gift to him.
questions.question:
다음 주어진 문장과 의미가 같은 것은?
She sent not only a letter but also a gift to him.
questions.explanation: 'not only A but also B'는 'B as well as A'로 바꿀 수 있습니다. 'not only a letter but also a gift'는 'a gift as well as a letter'와 같은 의미입니다.

options: Neither Sam nor Emma can swim well.
Emma as well as Sam can swim well.
Both Sam and Emma can't swim well.
Either Sam or Emma can swim well.
Emma can swim much better than Sam.
questions.question:
다음 주어진 문장과 의미가 같은 것은?
Not only Sam but also Emma can swim well.
questions.explanation: 'not only A but also B'는 'B as well as A'로 바꿀 수 있습니다. 'Not only Sam but also Emma'는 'Emma as well as Sam'과 같은 의미입니다.

questions.question:
다음 두 문장의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 어법상 어색한 것은? (정답2개)
• ⓐNot only my brother ⓑbut my friends ⓒlikes this song.
• She enjoys not only ⓓreading but also ⓔto write.
questions.explanation: ⓒ: 동사는 뒤(B) my friends에 맞춰 likes→like. ⓔ: not only 뒤 병렬은 reading과 대응하는 writing(to write 아님).

options: We wanted him not only to be honest but also to work hard.
We wanted him to be honest as well as work hard.
We wanted him not only to be honest but also work hard.
We wanted him to be honest as well as hard work.
We wanted him not only to work hard also to be honest.
questions.question:
다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 바꿔 쓸 때, 알맞은 것은?

• We wanted him to be honest.
• We also wanted him to work hard.
questions.explanation: 'not only A but also B'는 A와 B의 문법 형태가 같아야 합니다. 'to be honest'와 'to work hard'가 모두 to부정사로 병렬을 이루는 ①번이 알맞습니다.

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 총 개수는?

ⓐ He likes not only running but also to swim.
ⓑ Not only did she sing but she also dances last night.
ⓒ Her smile as well as her words comforts me.
ⓓ Not only Mike but also Sarah likes music.
ⓔ Not only the students but also the teacher were happy about the news.
ⓕ He as well as his friends have many books.
questions.explanation: 옳은 문장은 ⓒ(Her smile as well as her words comforts—앞 주어 smile 단수), ⓓ(Not only Mike but also Sarah likes—뒤 Sarah 단수) 2개. ⓐ to swim→swimming, ⓑ 도치+시제 오류, ⓔ were→was(the teacher), ⓕ have→has(He). 총 2개.

questions.question:
아래 문장 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?

ⓐ Mina likes not only tea but also coffee.
ⓑ Not only the song but also the movie is famous.
ⓒ Not only I but also Ms. Lee want to be a teacher.
ⓓ David speaks not only French but Japanese.
ⓔ Jenny is good at singing as well as dance.
ⓕ Peter as well as his brothers are really good at soccer.
questions.explanation: ⓒ: 동사를 뒤(B)인 Ms. Lee에 맞춰 want가 아니라 wants여야 합니다. ⓔ: singing에 맞춰 dance가 아니라 dancing이어야 합니다. ⓕ: 뒤(B)인 Peter에 맞춰 are가 아니라 is여야 합니다. 따라서 틀린 문장은 ⓒ, ⓔ, ⓕ입니다.

questions.question:
아래 문장 중 어법상 올바른 것을 모두 고른 것은?

ⓐ She isn't interested not only in drawing but also in painting.
ⓑ Ken not only cooks well but also clean well.
ⓒ I as well as you are ready to leave.
ⓓ Not only I but also my sister is good at science.
ⓔ Not only my friends but also my sister don't like scary movies.
ⓕ Amy has not only a bright smile but also a kind heart.
ⓖ Not only the pen but also the notebook is on sale today.
questions.explanation: ⓐ: isn't와 not only가 겹쳐도 병렬 형태가 맞아 옳습니다. ⓓ, ⓕ, ⓖ는 동사 수일치와 병렬이 모두 옳습니다. ⓑ: cooks에 맞춰 clean이 아니라 cleans여야 합니다. ⓒ: 뒤(B)인 I에 맞춰 are가 아니라 am이어야 합니다. ⓔ: 뒤(B)인 my sister에 맞춰 don't가 아니라 doesn't여야 합니다. 따라서 옳은 문장은 ⓐ, ⓓ, ⓕ, ⓖ입니다.
